title: 恐龙跑得有多快
subtitle: 看脚印隔多远就知道
character: wearing a burnt orange t-shirt, teal shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, flat shapes with soft woven texture and clean edges, dusty teal, sand and burnt orange

pages.zh:
我和爸爸在院子里赛跑。
我跑得很快，
可还是爸爸先到。
我问他，
恐龙跑得过爸爸吗？
pages.scene: The little boy running across a garden lawn beside his father, seen from close in front so the boy's face is large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, laughing as he runs.

pages.zh:
有的恐龙
比人跑得快多了。
有的连走路
都慢吞吞的。
差得很远。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three horizontal bars on a cream background all starting from the same left edge, the top one medium, the middle one the longest, the bottom one very short. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
跑得快不快，
先看腿。
腿长的一步
就迈出去好远，
步子不多也跑得远。
pages.scene: One long-legged dinosaur taking a big stride on a cream background, its legs stretched far apart. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
还要看小腿。
跑得快的恐龙，
小腿比大腿长。
跑得慢的
正好相反。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two leg outlines side by side on a cream background, each split into an upper and a lower part, the left one with a longer lower part and the right one with a longer upper part. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
用两条腿跑的
一般都快。
四条腿的身体太重，
跑不了几步
就得停下来歇。
pages.scene: On a cream background, two dinosaurs well apart from each other: on the left one slim two-legged dinosaur in mid-stride with both feet off the ground and its tail streaming straight out behind it; far to the right one heavy four-legged dinosaur with a smooth plain back standing still with all four feet planted.

pages.zh:
怎么知道它跑多快呢？
看脚印。
脚印隔得远，
说明它在跑；
隔得近，那是在散步。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two rows of footprints running across a cream background, the top row widely spaced and the bottom row closely spaced. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这些脚印
后来也变成了石头。
一串一串，
留在河边的泥地上，
一直留到今天。
pages.scene: One long line of fossil footprints preserved in dried mud on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
跑起来的时候
尾巴要翘起来。
头往前伸，
尾巴往后伸，
这样才不会栽跟头。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one running dinosaur seen from the side on a cream background with its head stretched forward, its tail lifted straight back, and a small triangle marking the balance point over its hips. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最大的那几种
其实跑不动。
身体太重了，
真跑起来
腿骨会受不住。
pages.scene: One enormous heavy dinosaur walking slowly with its feet planted on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
跑得最快的恐龙
有多快呢？
差不多
和骑自行车一样，
追得上骑车的大人。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one running dinosaur silhouette and one bicycle shape side by side on a cream background, each with an arrow of exactly the same length in front of it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它们有时候一起跑。
地面咚咚地响，
灰尘扬得老高，
好远好远
都看得见。
pages.scene: A group of dinosaurs running together across open ground with dust rising behind them, on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我又跑了一次。
这回我把两只手
往后甩，
像一条尾巴。
好像真的快了一点。
pages.scene: The little boy running towards the viewer across the lawn with both arms stretched straight back behind his hips, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, laughing.
